title: Geometric normal-slice comparison for supported cohomology
statement:
Fix the finite datum $k,\ell,E,n,A$ of [def-pur-conventions], with arbitrary $n\geq1$. Let $S$ be a $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X\to S$ and $Y\to S$ be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let $Y\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $T\to X$ be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], put $Y_T=Y\times_XT$ [def-pc-base-change], and suppose there is an etale $S$-morphism $h:T\to\mathbf A^{a+b}_S$, for integers $a,b\geq0$ [def-sbc-affine-space], with $Y_T=h^{-1}(\mathbf A^a_S)$ scheme-theoretically, where the coordinate subspace is cut out by the last $b$ coordinates. On the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], write $R\underline\Gamma_{Y_T}$ for the right derived functor [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] of the sheaf of sections with support: for an abelian sheaf $F$ on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ and an etale object $W\to T$, put $Y_W=Y_T\times_TW$; the underived sheaf assigns $\ker(F(W)\to F(W\setminus Y_W))$. For every $r\in\mathbf Z$ and geometric point $\bar t$ on $Y_T$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], there is a coordinate-induced isomorphism of complexes of $A$-modules
$$\bigl(R\underline\Gamma_{Y_T}(A(r))\bigr)_{\bar t}\simeq R\Gamma_{\{0\}}(\mathbf A^b_k,A(r)),$$
where the right side is ordinary etale supported cohomology [def-pur-support-cohomology], $\{0\}$ is the origin, and twists are [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. The comparison is compatible with further etale restriction of $T$ and with the identifications of twists $A(r)=A(b)\otimes_A A(r-b)$. If there is a fixed integer $c\geq0$ such that $\dim\mathcal O_{X,y}=\dim\mathcal O_{Y,y}+c$ for every $y\in Y$, with Krull dimension defined as the supremum of lengths of strict prime chains, then every such chart with $Y_T\ne\varnothing$ has $b=c$.

source.place: Tag 0FUE, lemma-etale-local-structure, for the geometry; Tag 09XP, section-cohomology-support, for supported derived sections. The geometric normal-slice comparison over an arbitrary k-base is an agent-formulated auxiliary assertion, not a theorem asserted by either of these tags. Over the base field itself (S = Spec k, X and Y smooth k-varieties) the corresponding assertion is Milne, Lectures on Etale Cohomology, Section 16, Theorem 16.7 (cohomological purity: R^r i^! F = 0 for r != 2c, R^{2c} i^! F = (i^*F)(-c)) with the etale-local standard model of Lemma 16.8, printed pp. 111--112 (literature/milne-lectures-on-etale-cohomology_LEC.pdf); Milne proves it by induction from the case m=c=1 of his 14.3. The arbitrary-base form is not cited from any SGA volume.
